items.title: Apple CEO John Ternus’ LinkedIn Profile Raises Eyebrows: What’s Missing? - Free Press Journal

The profile still lists him as Apple’s hardware engineering chief and omits much of his 25-year career and product contributions. LinkedIn users debated whether personal branding matters when professional achievements speak for themselves
